interview_answers.liveness_definition: Live = the app holds a running agent PTY for the session (tab open or inside the 5 s soft-close window). An agent that exited to the shell in an open tab stays live; out of scope. User reported: closing the tab should stop the session (2026-11-22).
interview_answers.late_events: A late hook event or a late end-of-file of a replaced PTY must not change liveness.
